:::{#thm-weibull}
#### Weibull density and hazard

If $T$ has the Weibull distribution with shape $\shape$ and rate $\rate$, then for $t > 0$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(t) &= \shape\rate t^{\shape-1}\text{e}^{-\rate t^\shape}\\
\h(t) &= \shape\rate t^{\shape-1}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::

::: proof

The CDF of $T$ is $F(t) = 1 - \surv(t)$
([survival function and CDF](random-variables.qmd#thm-survival-expressions-1)),
which is $0$ for $t < 0$ and $1 - \text{e}^{-\rate t^\shape}$ for $t \ge 0$.
This $F$ is continuous everywhere,
with a continuous derivative everywhere except possibly $t = 0$,
so

$$
\begin{aligned}
f &= F' \\
&= -\surv'
\end{aligned}
$$

is a density of $T$
([a piecewise-smooth CDF has its derivative as a density](random-variables.qmd#thm-cdf-derivative-density)).
This density is continuous at every $t > 0$,
so there the hazard is $f(t)/\surv(t)$
([hazard equals density over survival](random-variables.qmd#thm-hazard-dens-surv)):

$$
\ba
f(t)
&= -\frac{d}{dt}\text{e}^{-\rate t^\shape}
&& (f = -\surv') \\
&= \shape\rate t^{\shape-1}\text{e}^{-\rate t^\shape}
&& (\text{chain rule}) \\
\h(t)
&= \frac{\shape\rate t^{\shape-1}\text{e}^{-\rate t^\shape}}{\text{e}^{-\rate t^\shape}}
&& (\text{hazard is density over survival}) \\
&= \shape\rate t^{\shape-1}
&& (\text{cancel})
\ea
$$

:::
